description: EXPERIMENTAL: Duplicate a timeline clip, with its linked audio/video partner, onto the first tracks above it that are empty for the clip's time range. The copy keeps the clip's source in point and visible duration, is placed with an overwrite edit (nothing ripples), and is read back. A post-write mismatch is committed_unverified; inspect the timeline or use Undo. Fails without changes when no free track is available; add one with add_tracks.

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to duplicate

name: duplicate_clip
